# Expertise Profile: John B. Smith

## Methods Championed

### Relationship Inference
Smith developed a robust method for inferring relationships from synthetic
genotype data that is independent of population structure [smith2010robust].

### Association Mapping in Diverse Populations
A core expertise is association mapping validated across diverse synthetic
ancestry groups [smith2015association], with an emphasis on proper calibration.

### Multi-Source Integration
Smith develops frameworks that integrate multiple synthetic data sources to
improve association analysis power [smith2020integration].

## Recurring Critiques and Positions

### Diverse Ancestries are Essential
Studies limited to a single ancestry group miss important signal; association
studies must include diverse ancestries [smith2015association].

### Calibration Over Convenience
Ad hoc statistical methods without proper false positive control are unreliable;
principled, calibrated methods are preferred [smith2010robust, vale2023structure].
